description.zh: 快速看懂一个陌生代码仓库：统计语言和代码量、目录结构、依赖和框架、入口文件、测试和 CI，生成模块依赖图，整理上手文档，回答“某个功能在哪里实现”。只读分析，不修改代码。
description.en: Understand an unfamiliar codebase fast: languages and size, layout, dependencies and frameworks, entry points, tests and CI, module dependency graphs, onboarding docs, and where a feature lives. Read-only.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我项目在哪个目录，我先帮你摸清全貌
welcome_message.en: Tell me where the project is and I'll map it out

prompt.zh: 帮我看一下 ___ 这个项目：用什么语言和框架、入口在哪、有没有测试。
prompt.en: Give me an overview of ___: languages, frameworks, entry points and tests.

prompt.zh: 画出 ___ 的模块依赖关系，哪些是核心模块，有没有循环依赖？
prompt.en: Map module dependencies in ___: core modules and any cycles?

prompt.zh: ___ 这个功能是在哪里实现的？请求是怎么流转的？
prompt.en: Where is ___ implemented and how does the request flow?

prompt.zh: 为 ___ 写一份新人上手指南，包括本地运行和核心流程。
prompt.en: Write an onboarding guide for ___ with local setup and core flows.

prompt.zh: 评估 ___ 的技术栈和依赖，有哪些过时或风险点？
prompt.en: Assess the stack and dependencies of ___: anything outdated or risky?

prompt.zh: 列出 ___ 的目录结构，说明每个主要目录是做什么的。
prompt.en: Show the directory tree of ___ and explain each main folder.

zh: 每周一「10:00」扫描主仓库，汇总代码量、依赖和 TODO 变化
新成员入职当天「09:30」生成项目上手指南
每月 1 日「10:00」更新模块依赖图，标出新增的相互引用
每月 15 日「10:00」列出代码行最多的文件，供重构评估
每次发版前「15:00」检查依赖清单变化
每季度第一天「10:00」复核技术栈和过时依赖
en: Every Monday at 10:00, scan the main repo and summarize size, dependencies and TODO changes
On a new teammate's first day at 09:30, generate the onboarding guide
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, refresh the module graph and flag new mutual imports
On the 15th of each month at 10:00, list the largest files for refactoring review
Before each release at 15:00, check dependency changes
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, review the stack and outdated dependencies
